**Triage Summary:**

The 20 findings cluster into three package groups: OpenSSL/libssl3 (11 CVEs with fixes available), libgnutls30 (3 CVEs with fixes), and isolated issues in zlib1g and perl-base. Most findings are HIGH severity with very low EPSS scores (0.008–0.018), indicating minimal real-world exploit likelihood; the exception is CVE-2023-45853 (zlib1g, CRITICAL severity) which lacks a fix and has negligible EPSS (0.029). All fixable vulnerabilities have patches available, making remediation straightforward through dependency updates.

**Recommended Action:** Approve this build with a requirement to schedule immediate patching of OpenSSL, libgnutls30, and perl-base in the next maintenance cycle. Flag CVE-2023-45853 (zlib1g) for separate risk assessment—its CRITICAL rating conflicts with its low EPSS and no-fix status; verify if it's actually exploitable in your application context before escalating.
